name: Fillmatic
description: A Chrome extension for filling web forms with realistic test data.

highlights: One-click realistic names, addresses, emails, dates, and test payment data
Works with React and Vue controlled inputs
Handles ARIA widgets, rich-text editors, shadow roots, and iframes
Reusable Actions and custom Recipes for repeated workflows
Heuristic autofill works without AI or a backend
details.problem: Form testing is slow when realistic values must be entered across different frameworks and custom controls.
details.architecture: A Manifest V3 Chrome extension sends messages from the popup and shortcuts to a content script. The content script runs a failure-isolated autofill pipeline with native setters, widget adapters, and reusable Actions and Recipes. Data stays in chrome.storage.local, while the Astro site is a separate static marketing app.

name: Polychat
description: A local-first AI workspace for chat, images, and multilingual work.

highlights: Switch between Gemini, OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, and DeepSeek
Use focused assistant profiles and custom instructions
Stream rich Markdown responses with code, files, and message actions
Generate images and attach documents or images as context
Keep threads, images, and provider keys local with an encrypted BYOK vault
details.problem: Using different AI providers, conversation settings, and local chat history across separate tools creates unnecessary friction and privacy concerns.
details.architecture: A React client provides the workspace, profiles, streaming UI, image generation, and file context. An authenticated Hono API on AWS Lambda handles provider requests, while a Pages proxy protects the API boundary. Threads, images, preferences, and the encrypted BYOK vault are stored locally in IndexedDB.
